meaning: Source-specific evidence, not a calibration rectangle or proof that no physical common domain exists.

melts_guidance.locator: Answers to Questions: MELTS, rhyolite-MELTS and pMELTS
melts_guidance.composition: Mafic magmatic liquids; accuracy depends on composition and phase assemblage.
melts_guidance.supports: Nominal MELTS/rhyolite-MELTS limits only; the evaluator additionally requires P > 0.
melts_guidance.does_not_establish: Stable liquid for the exact retained BSE input, its redox/water state or Mg/Si variants. pMELTS is a different near-solidus calibration, not a remedy at 1 bar.

sossi_2020.locator: Results and Materials and Methods, printed pages 2 and 5-6
sossi_2020.temperature_meaning: Reported 1900 +/- 50 degrees C experiment, not a validated continuous interpolation domain.
sossi_2020.composition: Synthetic KLB-1-like Mg-Si-Fe-Al-Ca peridotite; Na2O and K2O each below 0.01 wt% in average glass.
sossi_2020.supports: Complete initial fusion and measured Fe redox at a BSE-like candidate condition.
sossi_2020.does_not_establish: Exact McDonough-Sun liquid stability or H-rich metal coexistence. The two most reduced samples lost about 10% of Fe by evaporation.

chaudhari_2025.locator: Tables 1-2 (pages 3, 5), Eq. 1 (page 8), Eq. 5 and extrapolation discussion (page 14)
chaudhari_2025.range_meaning: Envelope of buffered Table 2 data across different hosts, not a calibration rectangle.

preliminary_pure_H2_runs.meaning: Separate preliminary experiments; not the buffered regression domain.

chaudhari_2025.concentration_basis: ppm molecular H2 by weight (micrograms per gram)
chaudhari_2025.supports: Recalibrated H2 absorption; concentration/pressure fits at the Fe-FeO-H2O buffer.
chaudhari_2025.does_not_establish: An arbitrary-H2-fugacity standard without conversion, or H2 solubility in BSE at 2173.15 K and 1 bar.

marcum_2026.locator: Sections II.1 and IV.1; pinned ExoEOS table metadata
marcum_2026.range_meaning: Nominal lookup coordinates, not a claim of direct simulation coverage of every grid cell.
marcum_2026.composition: Supercritical MgSiO3-MgSiO3H4 binary, not the retained multicomponent BSE liquid.
marcum_2026.supports: A distinct hydrogen-bearing material EOS and its thermodynamic derivatives.
marcum_2026.does_not_establish: A molecular-H2 Henry law or MELTS endmember standard; its table and nominal MELTS temperature ranges do not overlap.

ma_h_implementation.supports: An integrable dry Ma excess scalar with ideal atomic-H dilution and supplied absolute standards.
ma_h_implementation.does_not_establish: H excess interactions, pressure response, H partition calibration or liquid phase stability. Finite positive T/P checks are mathematical input validation.

jiang_2025.composition: Fe-O-Si-H; reported alloy contains 5.2 wt% O and 4.8 wt% Si.
jiang_2025.supports: The calculated H partition coefficient changes from 18.2 for Fe-H to 11.8 for Fe-O-Si-H, demonstrating a composition effect.
jiang_2025.does_not_establish: A calibrated four-component scalar at the M2 candidate point, or permission to set all H interactions to zero.

badro_2018.range_meaning: The 22 new experiments; not an envelope of every datum in the combined regression.
badro_2018.composition: Metal-silicate MgO dissolution experiments; metal composition enters the partition model.
badro_2018.supports: Measured Mg transfer into metal at high T/P; the study resolves no pressure dependence in its fitted data.
badro_2018.does_not_establish: A low-pressure omission bound at 2173.15 K, or pressure independence of the different Fe-Si-O-H excess model.

fegley_2023.locator: Major Elements, Calcium, Aluminum, Potassium; Table 1; printed pages 19-25 and 61
fegley_2023.range_meaning: Pressure range of the reported dry-BSE condensation curves; not experimental calibration of our providers.
fegley_2023.composition: Palme-O'Neill BSE model, distinct from the retained McDonough-Sun projection and the M2 H/He inventory.
fegley_2023.supports: Background-element vapor channels exist and predicted condensation depends on liquid activities.
fegley_2023.does_not_establish: Quantitative Al/Ca/K/Ti/Cr/P transfer errors or their effect on an H-rich BSE metal boundary.

candidate_assessment.interpretation: Retain this one point for numerical integration controls. The cited experiments and formal alloy domain do not certify a coupled BSE material domain.
